mapper.select: select mn.*,pro.P_Name as projectName,reg.audit_status as auditStatus,reg.audit_comment as auditComment from Pre_Project_Solution mn left join Pre_Project pro on mn.project_id = pro.P_ID left join Project_Register_Info reg on mn.project_register_info_id = reg.id where mn.id=#{id}
select mn.* from Pre_Project_Solution_Details mn where mn.solution_id=#{id} and mn.del_flag=1 and mn.status=1
